name: Save Health export to Files
description: English UI. Run after health/export-all once the share sheet is visible (the zip takes ~1 minute; this flow times out on step 1 until then — rerun). Taps 'Save to Files', then the Files picker's Save button. That picker's accessibility tree is heavy and WDA source reads often time out, so Save is a top-right coordinate tap (0.89, 0.096) guarded by a postcondition: the picker's Save button is gone (true after a save and while a replace prompt covers it). If the last step times out and a 'Replace Existing Item?' alert is showing, answer it with the native alert route (Keep Both), as health/export-keep-both does in zh-CN. English labels still need a run; the zh-CN twin is hardware-proven.
